method: descriptor-interval inversion: min_V(E) is a volcano in the descriptor, so the feasible set is the interval(s) where min_V <= cap; endpoints are refined by root solve and the Fe normal is integrated over them
analytic_vs_mc: the analytic baseline (0.8120) sits 1.3 percentage points above the frozen 1,000-draw Monte-Carlo value (0.7990); the binomial standard error at n=1000, p=0.8 is 1.26 pp, so the two agree within one standard error and the inverted values are reported on the analytic scale
